fixture.description: The repo keeps its tests in test/ by feature (test/money.test.js covers src/money.js). The diff adds src/duration.js, an exported parseDuration() with real branching logic (a regex parse, a validation throw, a unit table) and no test anywhere, plus src/duration-types.js, which only exports constants. There is no file-name convention to check: the test-quality reviewer has to judge that new behaviour lacks tests, and that the constants file needs none.

must_not_flag: a missing test for src/duration-types.js (constants only)

grader.rubric: PASS if the report has a finding (in the main report or Quality section, at SUGGESTED severity or higher; not only in Plausible or Refuted) that the new exported parseDuration() in src/duration.js has no tests, ideally naming what to cover (valid input such as '1h30m', and the invalid-input throw). FAIL if no such finding appears, or if the report demands a test for src/duration-types.js, which only exports constants. Findings about parseDuration's behaviour on other grounds are fine and do not by themselves satisfy or fail the case.

expected_behavior: The test-quality reviewer flags that parseDuration() is new exported logic with no test
The finding names the cases a test should cover (a valid duration, the invalid-input throw)
expected_not_behavior: Does NOT demand a test for src/duration-types.js (constants only)
Does NOT demand a test for the unchanged src/money.js (test/money.test.js covers it)
